result:
Every Tuesday, the town clock lost one minute.

No one noticed at first. The baker still opened his shop at seven, the school bell still rang at eight-thirty, and the last bus still left at six. But after a year, the clock was nearly an hour behind, and people began arriving strangely early for things.

The baker found time to sit with his coffee. Children invented a game in the schoolyard before lessons. A woman waiting for the bus struck up a conversation with a man she had seen every evening for twelve years.

The council called a meeting to discuss repairs. It began almost an hour late, though everyone agreed they had never enjoyed a meeting more.

In the end, they fixed the clock. But the baker kept his chair by the window, the children kept their game, and the woman and the man began taking an earlier bus together.
